overall.basis: Front = facade labelled 'elewacja frontowa' (picture 3) = entrance facade = bottom of the plan. Closed body measured over outer wall faces: width 7.56 (printed outer chain '756', matches the wall-to-wall pixel span) and depth 8.76 (printed outer chain '876'); excluded: the unroofed terrace on the right and the unroofed entrance landing at the front. Height 5.85 = ridge +5,53 minus ground -0,32 printed in section 5, equal to the published 'Wysokosc budynku 5,85 m'. Published built-up area 66,88 m2 is a separate fact (7.56 x 8.76 = 66.23).

bodies.where: single rectangular single-storey block, hip roof over the whole body

mainRoof.notes: Four-slope hip roof over the 7.56 x 8.76 rectangle; the front and rear elevations show the hip end as a triangle (apex), the side elevations a near-triangle with a very short flat top, and the site plan shows a short ridge running front-to-back (about 1.2-1.7 m, TRACED; 8.76 - 7.56 = 1.20 for equal pitches), so the house reads almost as a pyramid. Eaves overhang about 0.8 m all round (dashed roof outline on the plan, TRACED). Pitch is not printed anywhere; traced about 30 deg from the section and about 31 deg from the elevations (TRACED, not a source value). Two chimneys, red-brown ceramic tiles.
